scope: Local optimizer diagnostic, existing validation selection only. Training monotonicity is algorithm audit, not generalization. No convergence/global optimum claim on budget stop. No fresh or intact eval.
design: Rank64 counterpart to H299: same core96, documents, payload seed, eight full-gradient iterations and training-only Armijo grid. Compare step0 and selected checkpoint at both ranks. Same gradient-evaluation budget, not equal FLOPs. Rank32 results reused without rerunning.
